_about: Public-domain August Tholuck (1799-1877, professor at Halle) in pre-1930 English translations: Guido and Julius (tr. J. E. Ryland, 1854), the Gospel of St John (tr. A. Kaufman, 2nd ed., 1842), Romans (2 vols, tr. Robert Menzies, 1833-36), the Sermon on the Mount (2 vols, tr. Robert Menzies, 1834-37), Hebrews (2 vols, tr. James Hamilton, 1842) and Light from the Cross (1858), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 15 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

tholuck-guido-julius-1854: Guido and Julius; or, Sin and the Propitiator, tr. Jonathan Edwards Ryland (Boston: Gould & Lincoln, 1854)
tholuck-john-1842: Commentary on the Gospel of St. John, tr. A. Kaufman, second edition (New York: Saxton & Miles, 1842)
tholuck-romans-1: Exposition of St Paul's Epistle to the Romans, vol. 1, tr. Robert Menzies, Biblical Cabinet V (Edinburgh: Thomas Clark, 1833)
tholuck-romans-2: Exposition of St Paul's Epistle to the Romans, vol. 2, tr. Robert Menzies, Biblical Cabinet XII (Edinburgh: Thomas Clark, 1836)
tholuck-sermon-mount-1: Exposition of Christ's Sermon on the Mount, vol. 1, tr. Robert Menzies, Biblical Cabinet VI (Edinburgh: Thomas Clark, 1834); the translator's name OCRs as MENZIE8, so it is not machine-checked
tholuck-sermon-mount-2: Exposition of Christ's Sermon on the Mount, vol. 2, tr. Robert Menzies, Biblical Cabinet XX (Edinburgh: Thomas Clark, MDCCCXXXVII)
tholuck-hebrews-1: A Commentary on the Epistle to the Hebrews, vol. 1, tr. James Hamilton, Biblical Cabinet XXXVIII (Edinburgh: Thomas Clark, 1842)
tholuck-hebrews-2: A Commentary on the Epistle to the Hebrews, vol. 2, tr. James Hamilton, Biblical Cabinet XXXIX (Edinburgh: Thomas Clark, 1842)
tholuck-light-from-cross-1858: Light from the Cross: Sermons on the Passion (Philadelphia: W. S. & A. Martien, 1858; translator not named)
